cards.title: Lavender cologne
cards.evidence_summary: Existing fresh-lavender reference descriptions plus exact citrus-flower products motivate a cologne hypothesis.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Use citrus-flower lift around the lavender recognizer before investigating heavier support; a cologne structure does not require an amberwood chassis.
function_map: Lavender: protected recognizer only when required by the brief.
Neroli-type flower and petitgrain-type leaf: separate transition hypotheses.
Drydown support: compare a restrained version with the control.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Lavender cologne control.
comparison.change: Compare one neroli or petitgrain bridge at a time, without changing the lavender block.
comparison.question: Does the citrus-flower bridge preserve lavender beyond the initial freshness?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Official perfume notes are architecture only, not a formula or evidence of Ambrox absence.
Neroli and petitgrain are not stock substitutes.

cards.title: Green barbershop lavender
cards.evidence_summary: Official aromatic references support distinguishing herbal-green fougere texture from mineral amberwood effects.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Test an herbal-green bridge and dry mossy impression around a legible lavender core; keep sweetness an independent axis.
function_map: Mossy/dry support: texture hypothesis, not a compulsory material.
negative_space: Sweet amber turning the target gourmand

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Green barbershop lavender control.
comparison.change: Omit the herbal bridge while keeping other blocks fixed.
comparison.question: Does the herbal facet add a barbershop recognizer or merely medicinal sharpness?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Modern commercial descriptions do not reveal historical or proprietary formula quantities.

cards.title: Vanillic-resin lavender
cards.evidence_summary: Lavender-vanilla commercial architecture and a named balsamic benzoin grade support a softer route than mineral amberwoods.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Separate rounded vanillic warmth from resin body, then ask whether either improves the lavender transition.
function_map: Benzoin-type balsamic body: optional second dimension, not automatically needed.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Vanillic-resin lavender control.
comparison.change: Compare the minimal lavender-vanillic control against a resin-bridge alternative.
comparison.question: Does resin add texture beyond sweetness already supplied by the vanillic block?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Siam benzoin is not interchangeable with Sumatra benzoin or a generic amber base.
No skin longevity is inferred.

cards.title: Soft musky lavender
cards.evidence_summary: Official lavender-musky architecture and distinct musk descriptions support testing texture independently of woody-amber power.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Compare a restrained soft-musk cushion with a fruit-associated musk bridge; do not maximise musk or assume the two are redundant.
function_map: Helvetolide-type fruity musk: alternative bridge, not an obligatory layer.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Soft musky lavender control.
comparison.change: Run a soft-musk versus fruity-musk alternative while preserving the target block.
comparison.question: Does the musk retain lavender identity or leave an unrelated clean drydown?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Manufacturer tenacity language is not delivered concentration or perfume longevity.
A referenced perfume is not certified Ambrox-free.

cards.title: Lavender and orange blossom
cards.evidence_summary: Libre's official architecture pairs lavender and orange blossom; natural flower oil and absolute remain different products.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Treat fresh neroli and fuller orange-flower absolute as different bridge directions, with lavender/floral balance explicitly tested.
function_map: Orange-flower absolute: fuller alternative, not a synonym.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Lavender and orange blossom control.
comparison.change: Compare flower-oil and flower-absolute bridge variants rather than combining both by default.
comparison.question: Which flower register bridges the lavender while respecting floral restraint?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Marketed architecture does not provide Libre's formula.
Exact product and extraction matter; no automatic inventory substitution.

cards.title: Lavender with iris texture
cards.evidence_summary: Official lavender/iris references motivate a powder-texture direction, while methyl-ionone grades remain product-specific.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Separate cool aromatic recognition from a dry cosmetic or woody-violet texture; preserve whichever iris profile the user actually asked for.
function_map: Exact methyl-ionone grade: testable texture candidate.
Warm support: optional contrast, not automatic sweetness.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Lavender with iris texture control.
comparison.change: Compare the control with one iris-texture block; assess recognizer retention.
comparison.question: Does iris texture deepen the transition without turning the perfume into lipstick or violet powder?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Orris Liquid remains excluded for compounding.
Methyl Ionone Gamma Coeur is not AIMI or a whole orris extract.

cards.title: Lavender incense
cards.evidence_summary: An official lavender-incense reference and distinct olibanum extracts motivate a non-amberwood resin route.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Contrast aromatic lift with an incense impression; compare volatile oil character against denser resinoid body rather than treating either as smoke.
negative_space: Tar or smoke becoming the target

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Lavender incense control.
comparison.change: Oil-versus-resinoid bridge comparison with the aromatic core unchanged.
comparison.question: Does a resin bridge connect to lavender or separate into two unrelated smells?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Boswellia species, extraction and stock dilution stay distinct.
Neither extract alone establishes church-smoke reconstruction.

cards.title: Lavender licorice
cards.evidence_summary: The official Brin de Reglisse description supports lavender/licorice as an architectural reference only.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Use a licorice impression as a dark aromatic accent, not as permission to replace lavender with sweet anise.
function_map: Licorice impression: contrast hypothesis; exact material remains unresolved.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Lavender licorice control.
comparison.change: Compare omission of the licorice accent before adding more base.
comparison.question: Does licorice sharpen the lavender identity or turn it into confectionery?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: No glycyrrhizin, anethole, formula quantity or specific licorice chemical is inferred from product notes.

cards.title: Green mandarin versus ripe mandarin
cards.evidence_summary: The supplier identifies a green-harvest peel product distinct from red mandarin.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Use ripeness-specific citrus choice as a construction variable, not a rename of a generic orange top.
function_map: Ripe-mandarin comparison: requires its own exact product evidence.
negative_space: Green label misread as cut grass

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Green mandarin versus ripe mandarin control.
comparison.change: Compare authenticated citrus grades on the same control chassis; do not infer equal potency.
comparison.question: Does the harvest register improve recognizability without excessive sweetness?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: One grade's description does not calibrate a red/green replacement ratio.

cards.title: Grapefruit peel versus juice facets
cards.evidence_summary: Juice reconstitution and a tropical-fruity supplier description address different evidence domains.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Distinguish peel bitterness, juicy fruit body and sulfurous realism; investigate them as separate facets rather than adding generic citrus strength.
function_map: Sulfurous nuance: optional realism question, no dose imported.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Grapefruit peel versus juice facets control.
comparison.change: Compare one facet omission at a time; keep total perceived strength a separate observation.
comparison.question: Which facet is missing: peel, juice, or characteristic sulfurous detail?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Food matrix thresholds and concentrations do not become perfume OAVs.
Paradisamide is not grapefruit juice or a complete peel oil.

cards.title: Yuzu-specific citrus
cards.evidence_summary: Yuzu peel-oil work supports character-impact polar odorants beyond the bulk terpene profile.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Build a yuzu-led recognizer instead of relabeling lemon-grapefruit; use an authenticated reference to judge the distinction.
function_map: Exact yuzu peel reference: recognizer evidence.
Polar character facet: research question, not a procurement-ready formula.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Yuzu-specific citrus control.
comparison.change: Retain a generic citrus control and compare recognition blindly.
comparison.question: Can the proposed accord be distinguished from the generic citrus control as yuzu?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: The reported source occurrence is not proof of botanical exclusivity.
Yuzunone availability, permitted use and dose remain unbound.

cards.title: Galbanum bitter-green resin
cards.evidence_summary: Odor-directed analysis distinguishes galbanum character from its bulk terpene content.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Separate green-resin bite from leafy freshness and ask whether added trace character improves the intended green structure.
function_map: Trace character: prioritise investigation by sensory evidence, not peak size.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Galbanum bitter-green resin control.
comparison.change: Compare galbanum-block omission against a leafy control.
comparison.question: Does the green-resin facet earn its place beyond an ordinary leafy accord?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Oil and resinoid are not identical.
No trace ketone or pyrazine dose is admitted.

cards.title: Watery violet leaf
cards.evidence_summary: An exact leaf absolute and the existing flower-emission source address distinct plant organs.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Construct watery leaf freshness separately from violet-petal powder, then test whether a mossy/leathery transition is appropriate.
function_map: Petal/powder block: excluded unless separately requested.
Mossy transition: hypothesis, not a measured drydown.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Watery violet leaf control.
comparison.change: Compare leaf-led and petal-led controls rather than merging their identities.
comparison.question: Does the leaf effect remain recognisable without borrowing violet powder?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Viola flower headspace does not characterise leaf absolute.
This card does not clear the Orris Liquid hold.

cards.title: Fresh distilled neroli
cards.evidence_summary: Neroli blossom oil and orange-flower absolute have different extraction identities.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Keep fresh green-floral bloom legible; use the absolute only as a separately tested warmer alternative.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Fresh distilled neroli control.
comparison.change: Compare the two exact product registers; do not assume equal-dose equivalence.
comparison.question: Is fresh flower clarity lost when a richer extract is used?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Missing neat stock is not permission to use the same volume of a dilute stock.

cards.title: Petitgrain flower-to-leaf bridge
cards.evidence_summary: Shared Citrus aurantium origin does not erase the distinction between twigs/leaves and blossoms.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Test a bitter-green leaf bridge behind a flower or citrus recognizer without relabeling it neroli.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Petitgrain flower-to-leaf bridge control.
comparison.change: Compare addition/omission of the leaf bridge on an unchanged flower control.
comparison.question: Does the leaf bridge connect the citrus to the heart or make it harsh?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Citronnier, bigarade and terpene-reduced products require separate identity records.

cards.title: Grandiflorum jasmine texture
cards.evidence_summary: Species-specific flower emissions and an exact grandiflorum absolute description are complementary, not equivalent evidence.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Separate fruity floral volume, indolic warmth and green/hay texture; decide which of these the brief actually needs.
function_map: Transparent floral support: hypothesis, not proof of natural equivalence.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Grandiflorum jasmine texture control.
comparison.change: Use a natural-texture omission while holding the recognizer structure fixed.
comparison.question: Does the natural texture improve the target or simply increase indolic weight?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Flower headspace is not absolute composition.
A natural's label does not prove superior liking.

cards.title: Tea-green jasmine
cards.evidence_summary: Jasmine species and tea cultivars vary, so a tea-jasmine bridge needs an explicit target register.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Test airy flower against green-tea texture; do not use indole or grassy sharpness as a universal tea proxy.
function_map: Tea-green texture: second axis requiring reference comparison.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Tea-green jasmine control.
comparison.change: Compare tea texture alone, flower control and a combined bridge.
comparison.question: Does the bridge suggest tea-flower continuity instead of two separate accords?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Tea chemistry is not a jasmine absolute analysis.
No tea-ingredient ratios or skin effects are imported.

cards.title: Soft muguet versus watery cyclamen
cards.evidence_summary: Named floral ingredients support distinguishing soft muguet volume from green-watery floral facets.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Use a clear bell-flower recognizer and test watery lift separately; adding every modern floral material is not a structure.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Soft muguet versus watery cyclamen control.
comparison.change: Compare one soft-floral control with one watery-floral alternative.
comparison.question: Does watery lift improve muguet recognition or dilute it into generic freshness?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Supplier use descriptions are not regulatory substitutions or universal equal-potency ratios.

cards.title: Ripe apple with controlled cider facets
cards.evidence_summary: Named apple-associated ingredients also carry cider, pineapple, strawberry or woody facets.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Keep crispness, ripe flesh and fermentation nuance separate; do not let apple body turn into tropical fruit shampoo.
function_map: Existing cultivar evidence: realism boundary, not a dose recipe.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Ripe apple with controlled cider facets control.
comparison.change: Compare body alternatives and a body-omitted crisp control.
comparison.question: Which body option supports apple recognizability without the strongest side character?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: IFF Fructone is not automatically a reseller's Fructone B.
Ethyl 2-methylpentanoate is not ethyl 2-methylbutyrate.

cards.title: Pear-to-musk continuity
cards.evidence_summary: A pear-associated musk descriptor and pear-food aroma study support different aspects of a continuity hypothesis.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Test whether a fruit-associated musk preserves a pear memory after the volatile recognizer fades; persistence must be smelled, not assumed from the label.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Pear-to-musk continuity control.
comparison.change: Compare with and without the fruit-associated musk bridge at predeclared timepoints.
comparison.question: Is pear still recognised later, or is only a pleasant musk left?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Helvetolide is not pear ester or a measured late-pear response curve.
No longevity or projection guarantee.

cards.title: Orchard fruit into a restrained floral heart
cards.evidence_summary: Official orchard references and an osmanthus descriptor suggest different fruit-to-flower bridge directions.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Compare transparent flower support with a restrained stone-fruit floral bridge while pear/apple remains the protagonist.
function_map: Osmanthus: alternate flesh/texture route, not mandatory luxury.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Orchard fruit into a restrained floral heart control.
comparison.change: Compare transparent and osmanthus-led bridges against a simple fruit control.
comparison.question: Does the added bridge extend fruit identity or merely make the heart more floral?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Commercial note pyramids are not disclosed formulas or measured similarity.
Osmanthus grade and product identity stay exact.

cards.title: Cassis bud-green versus berry-juice
cards.evidence_summary: A bud absolute's green-sulfurous descriptor is distinct from a juice reconstruction.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Use cassis bud character as a separate realism axis from sweet berry body; decide whether the target needs the bud at all.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Cassis bud-green versus berry-juice control.
comparison.change: Compare bud-present and bud-omitted variants with fruit body fixed.
comparison.question: Does bud character improve recognisability or just increase sulfurous sharpness?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: A bud extract is not berry essential oil.
Grapefruit-juice sulfur evidence does not supply cassis perfume concentrations.

cards.title: Raspberry floral-green complexity
cards.evidence_summary: Raspberry-juice work supports multiple facets; existing beta-ionone sensitivity research cautions against a single observer's verdict.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Explore floral-green realism separately from a sweet berry impression, with an omission control for the ionone-associated facet.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Raspberry floral-green complexity control.
comparison.change: Compare the complete hypothesis with one floral-detail omission.
comparison.question: Does the floral-green detail improve raspberry identity across observers?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Food aroma is not perfume calibration.
Beta-ionone sensitivity variation is not a universal anosmia assignment.

cards.title: Floral-green tea
cards.evidence_summary: Floral green-tea character depends on cultivar and processing; a green-smelling ingredient alone does not establish tea identity.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Keep fresh infusion, soft floral detail and leafy texture separate, using the leaf block only where the selected reference needs it.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Floral-green tea control.
comparison.change: Compare leaf-block omission against an authenticated tea reference.
comparison.question: Does the leafy detail make the target read as tea or simply greener?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Stemone is not a complete tea extract.
No tea-consumer preference is transferred to perfume.

cards.title: Sun-dried black-tea floral-woody texture
cards.evidence_summary: Omission-supported tea odorants and incomplete recombination illustrate why tea identity is more than a list of abundant peaks.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Investigate ionone-related and floral-alcohol texture as a tea bridge, without treating woody intensity as black-tea accuracy.
function_map: Tea recognizer: assessed against a reference.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Sun-dried black-tea floral-woody texture control.
comparison.change: Omit one block at a time, preserving the full control.
comparison.question: Does the ionone/floral bridge improve tea recognition without excess woodiness?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: The study used a deodorized tea matrix, not ethanol or skin.
Dihydro-beta-ionone remains a distinct ingredient grade.

cards.title: Roasted Dong Ding oolong
cards.evidence_summary: Infusion omission experiments support a roast/caramel block alongside floral-fruity material, not a generic smoke formula.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Separate roast from floral-fruity tea texture and retain both as independently adjustable design questions.
function_map: Roasted pyrazine block: candidate dimension, no dose imported.
Floral-fruity tea block: recognizer support hypothesis.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Roasted Dong Ding oolong control.
comparison.change: Compare the full hypothesis with roast-omitted and floral-omitted controls.
comparison.question: Does roast increase oolong recognition or make it smell like coffee or nuts?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Not every oolong is Dong Ding or heavily roasted.
Food grade rankings are not perfume-quality labels.
